newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Energy Equity makes A$29 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: Energy Equity makes A$29 mln placement.

text.p: Energy Equity Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it would raise A$29 million through a share issue of 24.8 million shares at A$1.16 each to international and domestic institutional clients of brokers Paterson Ord Minnett Ltd and SBC Warburg Ltd.
Energy Equity (EEC) managing director Maurice Brand said the capital raising would be used to repay existing debt of A$33 million, of which A$25 million carries sn interest rate of 12.56 percent.
"This will allow EEC to restructure its Balance Sheet and put in place a larger finance facility at significantly lower interest rates, Brand said.
"It will also provide EEC with flexibility to proceed with its expansion plans in Australia and Indonesia in both the oil and gas and power generation sector," he said.
Brand said that the capital raising would have no effect on the company's operating profit forecast of A$4 million for the year to June 30, 1997.

He said there would also be minimal effect on earnings per share for next financial year with EEC forecasting a profit in excess of A$20 million based on the Indonesian Sengkang gas and power project being commissioned in July 1997.
The project is a joint venture between EEC, Tenneco Inc and Indonesian group, PT Trihasra Sarana Jaya Purnama.
At 3.30 p.m (0530 GMT), EEC shares were five cents weaker at A$1.19.
